text: {"status":"partial","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview describes the initiative as aimed at modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s1","quote":"aimed at modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms"}]},{"text":"However, its platform scope lists three main platforms: the mobile application, the web streaming portal, and third-party smart TV integration.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s4","quote":"The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms."}]},{"text":"The documents don't list social media platforms in the platform scope or say which social platforms are involved.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":["The documents don't specify which social media platforms, if any, are covered by the initiative."],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
